app.name: FidgetWii
app.short_description: A fidget spinner for your Wii.
app.long_description:
Spin a fidget spinner on your TV.
Press A to flick it, point at it and hold B to grab and spin it by hand, shake the Wii Remote or rotate an analog stick to speed it up, and hold B to brake.
Pick from 12 colors or Rainbow with Left/Right or +/-. Your top speed, longest spin and total spins are saved to the SD card (apps/FidgetWii/record.txt).
Works with Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube controller and USB keyboard.
Spinner photo: "Yellow Fidget Spinner" by Daserino, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
